source.description: arq_uuid accepted from caller (KB entry-point) and interpolated into Cyborg API URL path in get_arq_by_uuid

sink.description: HTTP GET /accelerator_requests/{arq_uuid}: arq_uuid concatenated into URL path via "/".join([self.ARQ_URL, arq_uuid]) without UUID-format or path-character validation

stoppedAt.detail: get_arq_by_uuid (defined at cyborg.py:337) has no production call site in the 1388-file source set. grep confirms it appears only at its definition (cyborg.py:337) and in test infrastructure (tests/fixtures/cyborg.py:274-277, tests/unit/accelerator/test_cyborg.py:426-457). The test fixture (CyborgFixture) mocks the method via oslo_fixtures.MockPatch, confirming it IS called from production code, but that call site is not yet extracted. Calls to get_arq_by_uuid in test files are on local variables (self.client.get_arq_by_uuid) — a documented link-graph blind spot. CyborgFixture is used by compute manager and virt/libvirt driver tests, suggesting the production caller is in nova.virt.libvirt or a compute manager accelerator workflow. All previously checked callers (compute/api.py, compute/manager.py, compute/utils.py, conductor/manager.py, network/neutron.py) call other _CyborgClient methods, not get_arq_by_uuid.

sanitisationGaps: No UUID format check or path-character filtering visible between method parameter (line 337) and HTTP call (lines 358-359) in get_arq_by_uuid.
